properties.name: app.jwtSecret
properties.description: Secret key untuk signing JWT token (minimal 256 bits / 32 characters untuk HS256)

properties.name: app.jwtExpirationMs
properties.description: JWT token expiration time dalam milliseconds (default: 86400000 = 24 jam)

properties.name: app.jwtCookieName
properties.description: Nama cookie untuk menyimpan JWT token
